commercial_product.note: Avantor is a global supplier/distributor of products and services to the life sciences and advanced technologies industries. Brands include VWR (laboratory distribution), J.T.Baker (high-purity chemicals and reagents), Macron Fine Chemicals, NuSil (medical-grade silicones), Masterflex (peristaltic pumps and single-use fluid handling), Nalgene (labware), and Avantor Services (clinical services, biopharma production, lab and production services). Customers include major pharma, biotech, healthcare and education/government institutions. No proprietary therapeutic drug pipeline.

excluded_partner_owned: Avantor supplies materials and services into many sponsor-led clinical programs; client-sponsored trials are not Avantor's pipeline and are excluded.
